marc: quick smoke results for nereid-v1 (float32) -> nereid-v1-int8(per-channel) onboard. ran on staging cluster A. summary below.

marc: command I used:
```
./eval_embeddings --model nereid-v1 --quant int8_perchannel --dataset semantic-shortquery-5k --k 10 --metrics recall@1,recall@5,recall@10,silhouette
```

infra-bot: job 38291 finished in 4m12s — logs: https://ci.internal/runs/38291

marc: results (baseline = nereid-v1 float32)
- recall@1: baseline 0.748 -> int8 0.733 (drop 1.5%)
- recall@5: baseline 0.912 -> int8 0.907 (drop 0.5%)
- recall@10: baseline 0.948 -> int8 0.946 (drop 0.2%)
- silhouette (avg): baseline 0.34 -> int8 0.29 (noticeable)

anya: hmm silhouette drop is larger than recall loss. could be cluster tightness affected by quant noise. did you check centroid drift?

marc: yeah ran a quick centroid delta: mean L2 delta ~0.018, max 0.062. looks localized to ~12% of anchors (longtail queries).

samir: what batch size / microbatch settings on the infer side? quant can amplify microbatch K/V cache differences.

marc: inference args: `--batch 64 --microbatch 8 --seqlen 128` on a single A100. latency unchanged. cost per token down ~28%.

lucy: paste a shortlist example where recall@1 flipped? want to eyeball semantic drift.

marc: sure — query: "how to reset password on hosted db"
- baseline top1: doc#342 (correct)
- int8 top1: doc#198 (similar but paraphrase, slightly lower quality)

anya: that one looks like paraphrase mismatch. could be embedding norm scaling changed by quant. did you rescale embeddings (float cast) before indexing?

marc: yep we do L2-normalize both sides. numbers before norm: baseline norm mean 6.2, int8 norm mean 6.16 -> tiny shift.

samir: maybe target-specific calibration (learned scale or small affine) would recover silhouette while keeping cost gains. worth trying 1k-sample calibration map.

marc: good call. I'll run a 1k calibrate with `--calibrate affine --calib-samples 1000` and re-eval.

ops: FYI if this goes to dedicated pools we need an ops-runbook note: watch recall@1 drop >1% on production prompts.

marc: noted. next steps:
1) run 1k affine calibration and re-run recall+silhouette.
2) run contrastive holdout (20k) to check longtail.
3) if still bad, try per-channel int6 microquant (experimental).

lucy: also toss UMAP 2D of baseline vs int8 embeddings for the subset with centroid deltas — makes drift obvious.

anya: agree. can you attach the small viz when available? :eyes:

marc: will upload to the run link. quick question to the group: acceptable operational threshold for recall@1 delta for this onboard? my proposal is <=1.0% and silhouette drop <=0.05 absolute. thoughts?

samir: <=1% sounds fine for most customers, but flagging for PLG apps where top1 matters (search). make it configurable per-catalog.

lucy: +1 on proposal. add an eval note to the model card with the calibration recipe.

marc: cool. I'll push updates to the onboarding PR and run the calibration now. ping me if you want to join the run.

infra-bot: triggered job 38295 (calibration-run) by marc at 1765432160

marc: thanks all :thumbsup:
